snippet.title: 『Core Keeper』Introduction Movie【INDIE Live Expo 2025.11.29】
snippet.description:
The popular mining sandbox game, is coming to Switch 2!
Enjoy multiplayer with up to 8 players!

Owners of the original Switch ver can upgrade the game!
Stay tuned for details like pricing!

Launching on Nintendo Switch 2 on Jan 28, with major update on all platforms!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1621690/Core_Keeper/
